08 / GOOD TO KNOW

Common
questions.

A few useful answers before your first visit.

01How can I request an appointment?+

Use any Book appointment button to prepare a visit request here. You can then email it to the clinic or call them directly. The clinic will confirm availability.

02Who will I see at DENTIN?+

Practo lists Dr. Suryanarayana Sharma at DENTIN. He is listed as an oral pathologist, implantologist and dental surgeon. Your specific care team can be confirmed when arranging a visit.

03Will I need a scan or X-ray?+

That depends on your concern and the dentist’s examination. Digital scans and X-rays can help with assessment and planning when clinically appropriate.

04Where is the clinic?+

DENTIN lists its location in Gowlidoddy, Hyderabad, opposite Jayabheri The Nirvana and Art Boutique Hotel. Please confirm the address when booking, as online listings vary.
